headline: Chilean Steel and Mining Firm Grupo CAP Reports Q3 Net Loss Exceeding $70 Million
summary: Grupo CAP reported a third-quarter net loss attributable to controlling owners of over $70 million, deepening nine-month cumulative losses to $127.8 million amid challenging iron ore market conditions.
why: Grupo CAP is one of Chile's premier iron ore mining and steel manufacturing conglomerates.

impacts.name: Grupo CAP
impacts.why: Deepening net losses over Q3 reflect ongoing financial headwinds in global steel and iron markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Worsening quarterly net loss figures pressured company share prices on the Santiago exchange.
